description: The Easy Way to Store and Go Seagate Basic delivers simple drag-and-drop backup in a lightweight, compact design. The result? Up to 5 TB of extra storage for your computer in a portable hard drive that's perfect for life on the go. * This Seagate Basic Portable Drive image is for illustration purpose only. Give Your Computer Extra Portable Hard Drive Space Whether you want to free up hard drive space on your Windows, Mac, and Chrome book computer or simply back up files so that you've got a second copy, Seagate Basic makes it ridiculously easy - just drag and drop! With up to 5 TB of capacity, there's plenty of room for your growing collection of files. * This Seagate Basic Portable Drive image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Take Your Backup Hard Drive Anywhere Lightweight, compact and totally portable, Seagate Basic is designed so that you can bring loads of files wherever you go. Just slip the USB 3.0 external hard drive in your bag, head out and connect to your computer via the included cable. * This Seagate Basic Portable Drive image is for illustration purpose only.
